sentences.text:
Marjina Bibi & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal on 15 July, 2024
 15.7.2024
 Sl No.22
 Ct No. 29
 Sb
 Crm (A) 2371 of 2024

In Re : An application for anticipatory bail under Sect
 Code of Criminal Procedure filed in connection with Mur
 Station Case No. 10 of 2024 dated 14.01.2024 under Sect
 498A/326/307/506 of Indian Penal Code.
 And
 Marjina Bibi & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal
 Mr. Bitasok Banerjee
 Mr. Abdus Salam ...
 Ms. Baisali Basu
 Ms. Rita Datta ...
 Mr. Prosenjit Mukherjee
 Mr. Saptarshi Chakraborty ... for the
 1.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that petitioner no. 1 is the mother-in-law,
petitioner no. 2 is the sister-in- law and petitioner no. 3 is the married sister-in-law.
It is submitted that due to matrimonial dispute between the husband and the de facto complainant, a false complaint has been lodged.
The learned counsel has also referred to the order passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge in granting bail to the husband of the de facto complainant.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the de facto complainant and the learned counsel appearing for the State oppose the prayer for anticipatory bail.
3. Case diary is produced.

It appears that the F.I.R. was lodged on the basis of the alleged incidents have been taken on 29.3.2022.
There has been a comprehensive statement by the victim woman with regard to the assault.
The burn injuries appear to be accidental as recorded in the injury report.
5. On such consideration, we are of the view that custodial interrogations of the petitioners are not necessary.

6. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rampurhat, Birbhum and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973.

sentences.text: Petitioners shall co-operate with the investigation and shall make themselves available with the investigation as and when required by the Investigating Officer at a place to be indicated by the petitioners.
7. It is directed that the present petitioners shall appear before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rampurhat, Birbhum within two weeks and pray for regular bail from date.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
8. It is further directed that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
9.
Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is disposed of.
